expectations.text: Applies the honesty check: publishes only criteria that will actually be applied, acknowledging name recognition and topic mix will shape selection
expectations.evidence: The plan says to publish the criteria and weights, and it hints at factors outside the score. It mentions unblinding 'to balance the program' and lists a 'Speaker's ability to deliver (past talks, video...)' criterion. It never checks that the published rubric matches how talks will really be selected. It also never says that name recognition or draw will shape picks. Program balance and topic mix are not stated publicly as selection factors. The 'Fit with themes' criterion and the 'overlaps accepted talk' reason code only touch topic mix indirectly.
